MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the syllable hǎo, which part is the final? (1 mark)
   A. h
   B. o only
   C. ao
   D. hǎ

2. Which two words are said with a tone followed by a light syllable? (1 mark)
   A. wǒ and nǐ
   B. nǐ and hǎo
   C. dà and xiǎo
   D. bàba and gēge

3. Read the pinyin: yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The television is in the living room.
   B. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   C. The chair is under the table.
   D. The door is on the left.

4. Fill the blank: 椅子在桌子____。 (The chair is under the table.) (1 mark)
   A. 里
   B. 是
   C. 上
   D. 下

5. What do we call a word made of two syllables blended together? (1 mark)
   A. A disyllabic word
   B. A stroke
   C. A final
   D. An initial

6. Which day is 星期四? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Thursday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Tuesday

7. What does 明天 (míngtiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. To go
   C. To rest
   D. Mosque

8. Which Kiswahili day is Monday? (1 mark)
   A. Ijumaa
   B. Jumatatu
   C. Jumamosi
   D. Jumapili

9. Fill the blank: 祝你生日____! (Happy birthday!) (1 mark)
   A. 礼物
   B. 快乐
   C. 朋友
   D. 蛋糕

10. Which food group does 菠菜 belong to? (1 mark)
   A. Drinks
   B. Vegetables
   C. Meat
   D. Fruits

11. Which Chinese word means "to eat"? (1 mark)
   A. 肉 ròu
   B. 饮料 yǐnliào
   C. 茶 chá
   D. 吃 chī

12. What does 这是什么? ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is this?
   B. Who is this?
   C. Where is it?
   D. When is it?

13. In the song 头、肩膀、膝盖、脚, which word is a joint in the leg? (1 mark)
   A. 脚
   B. 肩膀
   C. 膝盖
   D. 头

14. What does 膝盖 (xīgài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Knee
   B. To brush teeth
   C. Hand
   D. To cry

15. Fill the blank: 太阳____大。 (The sun is very big.) (1 mark)
   A. 是
   B. 在
   C. 很
   D. 有

16. Which word is pronounced hóngshuǐ? (1 mark)
   A. 洪水
   B. 太阳
   C. 云
   D. 天气

17. What should you do first when you get a spoken instruction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess
   B. Act at once
   C. Walk away
   D. Listen to the whole instruction

18. Which word is pronounced tóngxuémen? (1 mark)
   A. 叫
   B. 同学们
   C. 早上好
   D. 再见

19. What does 谢谢 (xièxie) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello
   B. I, me
   C. Thank you
   D. Teacher

20. In the syllable jiào, what is the initial? (1 mark)
   A. i
   B. o
   C. ia
   D. j

21. Which sentence means "I love you."? (1 mark)
   A. 那是我弟弟。
   B. 这是我爸爸。
   C. 我爱你。
   D. 这是我妈妈。

22. Which Chinese word means "to speak"? (1 mark)
   A. 说 shuō
   B. 牙 yá
   C. 耳朵 ěrduo
   D. 笑 xiào

23. What does 雨 (yǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Very
   B. Small
   C. Rain
   D. Snow

24. Which punctuation mark is a small circle at the end of a statement? (1 mark)
   A. !
   B. 、
   C. 。
   D. ?

25. What does 女儿 (nǚ'ér) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is, am, are
   B. And
   C. Daughter
   D. Younger sister

26. How many strokes does 生 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 4
   D. 7

27. What does 刷牙 (shuāyá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To brush teeth
   B. Foot
   C. To use
   D. Ear

28. How many strokes does 雨 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 6
   C. 8
   D. 11

29. Read the pinyin: mén zài zuǒbian. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sofa is beside the door.
   B. The door is on the left.
   C. The television is on the table.
   D. There is a bed in the bedroom.

30. Which Chinese word means "below"? (1 mark)
   A. 下面 xiàmiàn
   B. 东西 dōngxi
   C. 桌子 zhuōzi
   D. 门 mén

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write a sentence about what you do on Monday and one about what you do on Sunday, with pinyin. (4 marks)

32. Give two habits for keeping your body clean. (2 marks)

33. Give two things to put in a reading journal. (2 marks)

34. Give three tips for following spoken instructions well. (3 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Good morning!" (2 marks)

36. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my mouth to speak." (2 marks)

37. Explain one way rain helps the environment and one way too much rain harms it. (4 marks)

38. Write a short text of five sentences saying what you eat for each meal, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

39. Explain why a healthy plate should have food from several groups and name two groups with their Chinese names. (4 marks)

40. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello, teacher!" (2 marks)

41. Describe how to say the initials b and p differently, and give one more pair like them. (4 marks)

42. Read the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马 and explain how the tone changes meaning. (4 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The window is above the sofa." (3 marks)

44. State three rules of stroke order and give an example of each. (3 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天 and 老师. (2 marks)

46. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." and "On Wednesday I go to school." (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — ao
   h is the initial and ao is the final. The tone mark sits on the a.

2. D — bàba and gēge
   The second syllable of bàba and gēge is neutral.

3. C — The chair is under the table.
   yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. is 椅子在桌子下。, which means "The chair is under the table.".

4. D — 下
   下 means under.

5. A — A disyllabic word
   Dis means two, so a disyllabic word has two syllables.

6. B — Thursday
   四 is four, so 星期四 is week four, Thursday.

7. A — Tomorrow
   明天 (míngtiān) means tomorrow.

8. B — Jumatatu
   Jumatatu is Monday. Jumamosi is Saturday and Jumapili is Sunday.

9. B — 快乐
   生日快乐 is happy birthday.

10. B — Vegetables
   菠菜 is spinach.

11. D — 吃 chī
   吃 (chī) means to eat.

12. A — What is this?
   什么 means what.

13. C — 膝盖
   膝盖 is the knee.

14. A — Knee
   膝盖 (xīgài) means knee.

15. C — 很
   很 means very and goes before 大.

16. A — 洪水
   洪水 is pronounced hóngshuǐ and means flood.

17. D — Listen to the whole instruction
   You need the whole message to follow it correctly.

18. B — 同学们
   同学们 is pronounced tóngxuémen and means classmates.

19. C — Thank you
   谢谢 (xièxie) means thank you.

20. D — j
   j is the initial. iao is the final.

21. C — 我爱你。
   我爱你。 (wǒ ài nǐ.) means "I love you.".

22. A — 说 shuō
   说 (shuō) means to speak.

23. C — Rain
   雨 (yǔ) means rain.

24. C — 。
   That is the Chinese full stop.

25. C — Daughter
   女儿 (nǚ'ér) means daughter.

26. A — 5
   生 has five strokes.

27. A — To brush teeth
   刷牙 (shuāyá) means to brush teeth.

28. C — 8
   雨 has eight strokes.

29. B — The door is on the left.
   mén zài zuǒbian. is 门在左边。, which means "The door is on the left.".

30. A — 下面 xiàmiàn
   下面 (xiàmiàn) means below.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 我星期一去学校。 wǒ xīngqīyī qù xuéxiào. 我星期天去教堂。 wǒ xīngqītiān qù jiàotáng. (Any correct sentences.)
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash your hands with soap (洗手), brush your teeth (刷牙), bathe often, wear clean clothes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: New words with pinyin and meaning, sentences you can read well, or a recording of yourself reading.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole instruction; catch the key words; ask for a repeat if unsure; show the answer by pointing or drawing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each tip.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 早上好! zǎoshang hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用嘴巴说。 wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: Rain gives water to crops, rivers and animals. Too much rain can cause floods that damage crops and homes.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the benefit and 2 marks for the harm.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼,喝茶。我午饭吃米饭和鸡肉。我晚饭吃米饭和菠菜。我喜欢水果。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng, hē chá. wǒ wǔfàn chī mǐfàn hé jīròu. wǒ wǎnfàn chī mǐfàn hé bōcài. wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct verbs and pinyin.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Each group does a different job. Vegetables and fruit (蔬菜, 水果) give vitamins, rice (米饭) gives energy, and meat (肉) helps the body grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 1 mark for each group named, 1 mark for the job.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 老师好! lǎoshī hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: b is said without a puff of air and p with a puff of air. Another pair is d and t (or g and k). You can test with a paper strip, which moves more with p.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for b, 1 mark for p, 1 mark for another pair, 1 mark for the paper test or description.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Māma qí mǎ, mǎ màn, māma mà mǎ. Mum rides a horse, the horse is slow, mum scolds the horse. The syllable ma changes meaning with the tone: mā mother, mǎ horse, mà scold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pinyin, 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for explaining the three ma words.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Top to bottom (三), left to right (好: 女 then 子), horizontal before vertical (十), 撇 before 捺 (人).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with an example.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天: tiān, sky, day. 老师: lǎoshī, teacher.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān. 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.
